blocks.en: Appendix: CCS Change Tables for NDA/ANDA/BLA Products

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 熟練使用 Appendix 六大表格（Table A–F）作為 CCS 變更的法規決策工具
blocks.en: Become proficient in using the six appendix tables (Table A–F) as a regulatory decision tool for CCS changes

blocks.zh: 區分 NDA/ANDA（Table A, C, E）和 BLA（Table B, D, F）的通報類別差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the differences in reporting category between NDA/ANDA (Tables A, C, E) and BLA (Tables B, D, F)

blocks.zh: 理解每種 CCS 變更所需的支持數據類型和範圍
blocks.en: Understand the type and scope of supporting data required for each kind of CCS change

blocks.zh: 掌握 Specific Considerations 欄位中的條件性降級/升級觸發因素
blocks.en: Master the conditional downgrade/upgrade triggers in the Specific Considerations column

blocks.zh: 建立 CDMO 日常工作中查表決策的實務流程
blocks.en: Establish a practical table-lookup decision workflow for a CDMO's daily work

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這六張表格就像醫院的分流表 (triage chart)。急診室（FDA）根據症狀嚴重程度（變更風險）將病患（supplement）分流到不同級別的處理通道。輕症（Annual Report）自行回家觀察；中等（CBE-30）需要留觀 30 天；重症（PAS）必須住院觀察到康復確認。而 Specific Considerations 就像醫師的臨床判斷——同樣的症狀在不同病史背景下，可能升級或降級處理。
blocks.en: These six tables are like a hospital triage chart. The emergency room (FDA) sorts patients (supplements) into different levels of care according to the severity of symptoms (change risk). Mild cases (Annual Report) go home and self-monitor; moderate cases (CBE-30) are kept for observation for 30 days; severe cases (PAS) must be admitted and observed until recovery is confirmed. And Specific Considerations are like the physician's clinical judgment: the same symptoms may be escalated or de-escalated depending on the patient's history.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Baseline vs Reality：表格提供的是「基線建議」(baseline recommendations)。實際通報類別可能因以下因素調整：
blocks.en: Baseline vs Reality: The tables give "baseline recommendations". The actual reporting category may be adjusted for the following factors:

blocks.zh: 向上調整（更嚴格）：累積變更效應、產品特殊風險（如高 pH、凍乾產品、蛋白質製品）
blocks.en: Adjusted upward (stricter): Cumulative effect of changes; product-specific risks (such as high pH, lyophilized products, protein products)

blocks.zh: 向下調整（更寬鬆）：CP 已核准、充分的風險評估、ICH Q12 工具、藥品短缺情境
blocks.en: Adjusted downward (more lenient): An approved CP, thorough risk assessment, ICH Q12 tools, drug shortage situations

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA vs BLA 的系統性差異：生物製品（BLA）的通報類別通常等於或高於化學藥品（NDA/ANDA）。一個顯著例子：molded/tubing glass 切換在 NDA/ANDA 是 CBE-30，但在 BLA 可以是 AR（除非是凍乾產品使用 molded vials）。
blocks.en: Systematic differences between NDA/ANDA and BLA: The reporting category for biologics (BLA) is usually equal to or higher than that for chemical drugs (NDA/ANDA). One notable example: switching between molded and tubing glass is a CBE-30 for NDA/ANDA but can be an AR for BLA (unless it is a lyophilized product using molded vials).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的客戶持有一個 mAb 產品的 BLA 和一個小分子注射劑的 NDA。兩個產品使用同一供應商的 Type I 玻璃瓶。供應商要切換到新的 tubing 玻璃。兩個產品應分別查哪張表？預期的通報類別有何不同？
blocks.en: Your client holds a BLA for a mAb product and an NDA for a small-molecule injectable. Both products use Type I glass vials from the same supplier. The supplier will switch to a new tubing glass. Which table should be consulted for each product? How do the expected reporting categories differ?

blocks.zh: 表格中多次出現 "FDA may consider a lower reporting category based on the circumstances"。這在實務上如何操作？需要主動提出還是 FDA 會自動考慮？
blocks.en: The phrase "FDA may consider a lower reporting category based on the circumstances" appears many times in the tables. How does this work in practice? Must the applicant raise it proactively, or will FDA consider it automatically?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Appendix 表格使用指南
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Guide to Using the Appendix Tables

blocks.zh: 六張表格的分類邏輯：
blocks.en: Classification logic of the six tables:

blocks.zh: 查表步驟：
blocks.en: Steps for using the tables:

blocks.zh: 確認申請類型（NDA/ANDA 或 BLA）→ 選擇對應的表格組（A/C/E 或 B/D/F）
blocks.en: Confirm the application type (NDA/ANDA or BLA) and select the matching set of tables (A/C/E or B/D/F)

blocks.zh: 確認變更類型（性質、來源/廠址、製造/加工）→ 選擇具體表格
blocks.en: Confirm the type of change (properties, source/site, manufacturing/processing) and select the specific table

blocks.zh: 找到對應的 Proposed Change → 查看建議的 Reporting Category 和 Required Data
blocks.en: Find the corresponding Proposed Change and read the recommended Reporting Category and Required Data

blocks.zh: 檢查 Specific Considerations 欄位 → 是否有降級/升級條件適用
blocks.en: Check the Specific Considerations column for any applicable downgrade/upgrade conditions

blocks.zh: Table A: Changes to the Properties of Glass Vials and Stoppers — NDA/ANDA Table A：玻璃瓶與瓶塞性質變更 — NDA/ANDA
blocks.en: Table A: Changes to the Properties of Glass Vials and Stoppers — NDA/ANDA

blocks.zh: Table A 的風險階梯就像換車零件的審查層級：
blocks.en: The risk ladder of Table A is like the review levels for changing car parts:

blocks.zh: PAS（換引擎 / 換車架）：從玻璃換成塑料，就像把汽油車引擎換成電動馬達——根本性變更，必須重新驗證
blocks.en: PAS (changing the engine or chassis): Changing from glass to plastic is like replacing a gasoline engine with an electric motor: a fundamental change that must be revalidated

blocks.zh: CBE-30（換同型號但不同尺寸的輪胎）：Stopper dimensions 變更——功能相似但規格不同，需確認安全性
blocks.en: CBE-30 (changing to the same model of tire in a different size): A change in stopper dimensions: similar function but different specifications, so safety must be confirmed

blocks.zh: AR（換同型號的輪胎品牌）：同規格供應商切換——風險最低，事後報告即可
blocks.en: AR (changing the tire brand for the same model): A supplier switch with the same specifications: lowest risk, reported after the fact

blocks.zh: 重點提示 凍乾產品的特殊升級
blocks.en: Key Notes: Special Upgrade for Lyophilized Products

blocks.zh: Lyophilized Products 的風險升級：Table A 中 molded/tubing glass 切換對一般注射劑是 CBE-30，但對凍乾產品升級為 PAS。原因：不同類型的玻璃（molded vs tubing）壁厚不同，直接影響凍乾過程中的熱傳導效率。較厚的 molded glass 可能導致凍乾 cake 結構不均勻、殘留水分過高、甚至 collapse。因此需要重新驗證凍乾製程。
blocks.en: Risk escalation for lyophilized products: In Table A, switching between molded and tubing glass is a CBE-30 for ordinary injectables but is upgraded to a PAS for lyophilized products. The reason: different glass types (molded vs tubing) have different wall thicknesses, which directly affects heat transfer efficiency during lyophilization. Thicker molded glass may lead to a non-uniform cake structure, excessive residual moisture, or even collapse. The lyophilization process therefore needs to be revalidated.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示：如果你充填凍乾產品，CCS 變更的法規門檻通常比液態注射劑高。在規劃 CCS dual sourcing 時，必須將凍乾製程驗證的時間和成本納入計算。
blocks.en: Implication for CDMOs: if you fill lyophilized products, the regulatory threshold for CCS changes is usually higher than for liquid injectables. When planning CCS dual sourcing, the time and cost of lyophilization process validation must be included in the calculation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境 — Dual Sourcing 策略：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: dual sourcing strategy:

blocks.zh: 你的客戶想為其 NDA 小分子注射劑建立第二玻璃瓶供應商。根據 Table A Footnote 2：
blocks.en: Your client wants to set up a second glass vial supplier for its small-molecule NDA injectable. According to Table A Footnote 2:

blocks.zh: 最佳情境：新供應商提供相同 type/coating/dimensions 的玻璃瓶 → Annual Report 即可 → 實施時間最短
blocks.en: Best case: The new supplier provides glass vials of the same type/coating/dimensions → Annual Report is sufficient → shortest time to implementation

blocks.zh: 次佳情境：需切換 molded→tubing 或反之（非凍乾產品）→ CBE-30 → 約 30 天
blocks.en: Second-best case: A switch from molded to tubing or vice versa is needed (non-lyophilized product) → CBE-30 → about 30 days

blocks.zh: 最嚴格情境：不同 glass composition/type → PAS → 6-12 個月審查
blocks.en: Strictest case: A different glass composition/type → PAS → 6-12 months of review

blocks.zh: 因此，選擇第二供應商時，應優先尋找能提供相同規格玻璃瓶的供應商，以獲得最低的法規門檻。
blocks.en: Therefore, when choosing a second supplier, give priority to suppliers that can provide glass vials of the same specifications, to obtain the lowest regulatory threshold.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 stopper 材料變更（PAS）比 stopper 尺寸變更（CBE-30）的通報類別高？從風險角度分析兩者的差異。
blocks.en: Why is the reporting category for a stopper material change (PAS) higher than for a stopper dimension change (CBE-30)? Analyze the difference between the two from a risk perspective.

blocks.zh: Stopper 供應方式從 unprocessed 改為 RTU 只需 CBE-30。這對 CDMO 的瓶塞處理 (stopper processing) 流程有什麼影響？是否意味著簡化了 CDMO 的作業？
blocks.en: A change of stopper supply from unprocessed to RTU needs only a CBE-30. What effect does this have on the CDMO's stopper processing workflow? Does it mean the CDMO's operations are simplified?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Table A 決策要點
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Key Decision Points for Table A

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA 產品的 CCS 性質變更通報階梯：
blocks.en: Reporting ladder for CCS property changes in NDA/ANDA products:

blocks.zh: 關鍵 Footnote 2 — 隱藏的 Annual Report 路徑：如果僅變更玻璃瓶供應商（supplier），且玻璃類型、塗層和尺寸均未變更，可以用 Annual Report 通報。這是 CDMO dual sourcing 策略中最有利的法規路徑。
blocks.en: Key Footnote 2: the hidden Annual Report pathway: If only the glass vial supplier changes, and the glass type, coating, and dimensions are all unchanged, the change can be reported in an Annual Report. This is the most favorable regulatory pathway in a CDMO dual sourcing strategy.

blocks.zh: Table B: Changes to the Properties of Glass Vials and Stoppers — BLA Table B：玻璃瓶與瓶塞性質變更 — BLA
blocks.en: Table B: Changes to the Properties of Glass Vials and Stoppers — BLA

blocks.zh: Table A 和 Table B 的差異就像國內航班 vs 國際航班的安檢差異。你以為國際航班（BLA）一定比國內航班（NDA/ANDA）安檢更嚴格，但實際上某些項目國際航班反而更有彈性（如某些國家的轉機免簽）。關鍵是要逐項查表，不能一概而論。
blocks.en: The difference between Table A and Table B is like the difference in security screening between domestic and international flights. You might assume international flights (BLA) always have stricter screening than domestic flights (NDA/ANDA), but in some respects international flights are actually more flexible (such as visa-free transit in some countries). The key is to check the table item by item and not generalize.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 BLA 特殊考量
blocks.en: Key Notes: Special Considerations for BLA

blocks.zh: Footnote 2 的重要性（BLA 版）：Table B 的 footnote 2 指出，如果 glass composition/type 變更中「沒有改變 product-contact material 或 dimensions」，可以用 Annual Report。這為 BLA 產品提供了一條比 NDA/ANDA 更寬鬆的路徑。
blocks.en: The importance of Footnote 2 (BLA version): Footnote 2 of Table B states that if a glass composition/type change involves "no change in product-contact material or dimensions", an Annual Report may be used. This gives BLA products a more lenient path than NDA/ANDA.

blocks.zh: BLA Stopper 供應方式 → 可降至 AR：如果是供應商自行提供 pre-processed stoppers 且供應商內部的加工方式變更，FDA 可能接受 Annual Report。這對使用 RTU stoppers 的 CDMO 是好消息。
blocks.en: BLA stopper supply method → can be lowered to AR: If the supplier itself provides pre-processed stoppers and changes its own internal processing method, FDA may accept an Annual Report. This is good news for CDMOs that use RTU stoppers.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 BLA 的 molded/tubing glass 切換通報類別（AR）比 NDA/ANDA（CBE-30）更低？這是否意味著 BLA 產品的風險更低？
blocks.en: Why is the reporting category for switching molded/tubing glass lower for BLA (AR) than for NDA/ANDA (CBE-30)? Does this mean BLA products carry lower risk?

blocks.zh: Table B 的 vial dimensions 變更需要 "Additional accelerated and real time stability data as needed (e.g., concurrent stopper change)"。Table A 沒有這項要求。為什麼生物製品需要額外的穩定性數據？
blocks.en: Table B requires "Additional accelerated and real time stability data as needed (e.g., concurrent stopper change)" for vial dimension changes. Table A has no such requirement. Why do biologics need additional stability data?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Table A vs Table B 比較
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Table A vs Table B Comparison

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA vs BLA 的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences between NDA/ANDA and BLA:

blocks.zh: 意外發現：BLA 不一定比 NDA/ANDA 更嚴格。Molded/tubing 切換，BLA 反而可以用 Annual Report，比 NDA/ANDA 的 CBE-30 更寬鬆。這是因為 2021 年的 BLA CMC 指引有專門處理此類變更的條款。
blocks.en: Unexpected finding: BLA is not necessarily stricter than NDA/ANDA. For a molded/tubing switch, a BLA can actually use an Annual Report, which is more lenient than the CBE-30 for NDA/ANDA. This is because the 2021 BLA CMC guidance has provisions that specifically address this type of change.

blocks.zh: Table C: Changes to the Source or Site of Manufacture — NDA/ANDA Table C：來源或製造廠址變更 — NDA/ANDA
blocks.en: Table C: Changes to the Source or Site of Manufacture — NDA/ANDA

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Source/Site 變更
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Source/Site Changes

blocks.zh: Table C 的核心邏輯：Source/Site 變更（同一供應商不同廠址）風險較低，因為供應商的品質系統和規格控制是統一的。因此，多數變更只需 Annual Report 或 CBE-30。
blocks.en: The core logic of Table C: Source/site changes (the same supplier at a different site) carry lower risk because the supplier's quality system and specification controls are uniform. Most changes therefore need only an Annual Report or a CBE-30.

blocks.zh: 「同一供應商」的關鍵前提：Table C 明確標示 "no change in supplier"。如果是不同供應商的廠址變更，則應回到 Table A 評估。
blocks.en: The key premise of "same supplier": Table C explicitly states "no change in supplier". If the site change involves a different supplier, assess it against Table A instead.

blocks.zh: Testing Site 變更為何需要 CBE-30 而非 AR：測試廠址的變更涉及分析方法的轉移 (analytical method transfer)，可能影響結果的一致性。因此比製造廠址變更要求更高。
blocks.en: Why a testing site change needs a CBE-30 rather than an AR: A change of testing site involves analytical method transfer, which may affect the consistency of results. It therefore carries a higher requirement than a manufacturing site change.

blocks.zh: 同一供應商的廠址變更就像連鎖餐廳開新分店。如果麥當勞從 A 店搬到 B 店生產你的漢堡，因為用的是同一套 SOP、同一品牌的食材，你不太擔心品質變化（AR）。但如果他們把品質檢驗外包到一個新的實驗室（testing site），你會想確認新實驗室的檢驗能力是否等同（CBE-30）。
blocks.en: A site change at the same supplier is like a chain restaurant opening a new branch. If McDonald's moves production of your burger from Store A to Store B, you are not very worried about a change in quality (AR), because the same SOPs and the same brand of ingredients are used. But if they outsource quality testing to a new laboratory (a testing site), you will want to confirm that the new laboratory's testing capability is equivalent (CBE-30).

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO Dual Sourcing 的最佳化啟示：
blocks.en: Implications for optimizing CDMO dual sourcing:

blocks.zh: Table C 揭示了一個重要策略：如果你想建立第二供應來源，最低法規門檻的路徑是——選擇現有供應商的另一個製造廠址，而非更換到完全不同的供應商。例如：
blocks.en: Table C reveals an important strategy: if you want to establish a second source, the path with the lowest regulatory threshold is to choose another manufacturing site of the existing supplier rather than switch to an entirely different supplier. For example:

blocks.zh: Schott Germany → Schott India（同供應商不同廠址）→ AR
blocks.en: Schott Germany → Schott India (same supplier, different site) → AR

blocks.zh: Schott Germany → Nipro Japan（不同供應商）→ 需查 Table A，可能 PAS
blocks.en: Schott Germany → Nipro Japan (different supplier) → check Table A; possibly PAS

blocks.zh: 這是 CCS 供應鏈策略中非常實用的法規優化技巧。
blocks.en: This is a very practical regulatory optimization technique in CCS supply chain strategy.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 vial/stopper sterilization site 變更需要「驗證數據 (validation data)」而 manufacture site 變更只需「比較性資訊 (comparative information)」？
blocks.en: Why does a change of vial/stopper sterilization site require "validation data" while a change of manufacture site needs only "comparative information"?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶的 NDA 產品目前使用 Supplier A（德國工廠）的瓶塞。Supplier A 準備在中國開設新工廠生產相同瓶塞。這個情境應查 Table C 的哪一行？需要準備什麼數據？
blocks.en: Your client's NDA product currently uses stoppers from Supplier A (German plant). Supplier A plans to open a new plant in China to make the same stoppers. Which row of Table C applies to this scenario? What data need to be prepared?

blocks.zh: Table D: Changes to the Source or Site of Manufacture — BLA Table D：來源或製造廠址變更 — BLA
blocks.en: Table D: Changes to the Source or Site of Manufacture — BLA

blocks.zh: Table D 的 Specific Consideration 中提到「如果 vial/stopper 的 manufacturing or processing 將由藥品製造商自行執行」可能升級通報類別。這就像自家廚房 vs 外包中央廚房——如果生物製品廠自己做瓶塞加工（in-house processing），FDA 會更謹慎，因為這改變了供應鏈的控制點和責任劃分。外包給專業 CCS 供應商的風險控制通常比自行處理更可預測。
blocks.en: The Specific Considerations of Table D mention that the reporting category may be upgraded "if the manufacturing or processing of the vial/stopper will be performed by the drug product manufacturer itself". This is like your own kitchen vs an outsourced central kitchen: if a biologics manufacturer does stopper processing itself (in-house processing), FDA will be more cautious, because this changes the control points and the division of responsibility in the supply chain. Risk control by a specialized CCS supplier is usually more predictable than in-house handling.

blocks.zh: BLA Sterilization Site 的條件降級：如果供應商已經提供 pre-sterilized stoppers（RTU），且只是變更滅菌的廠址（例如從供應商的 A 工廠移到 B 工廠），FDA 可能接受 Annual Report。這是因為滅菌由供應商控制且在供應商的品質系統內管理，對藥品製造商的影響較小。
blocks.en: Conditional downgrade for BLA sterilization site: If the supplier already provides pre-sterilized stoppers (RTU) and only changes the sterilization site (for example, from the supplier's Plant A to Plant B), FDA may accept an Annual Report. This is because sterilization is controlled by the supplier and managed within the supplier's quality system, so the impact on the drug product manufacturer is smaller.

blocks.zh: 你的客戶持有 BLA，使用供應商提供的 RTU stoppers。供應商通知他們的滅菌將從德國工廠移到印度工廠。根據 Table D，通報類別是什麼？是否有降級可能？
blocks.en: Your client holds a BLA and uses RTU stoppers provided by a supplier. The supplier notifies them that sterilization will move from the German plant to the Indian plant. According to Table D, what is the reporting category? Is a downgrade possible?

blocks.zh: Table D 提到「drug product manufacturer 自行 processing」會升級通報類別。如果你的 CDMO 自行執行 stopper washing/siliconization/sterilization，這算是 "drug product manufacturer" 在做 processing 嗎？對通報類別有何影響？
blocks.en: Table D says that processing performed by the "drug product manufacturer" itself raises the reporting category. If your CDMO performs stopper washing/siliconization/sterilization itself, does that count as the "drug product manufacturer" performing processing? What effect does it have on the reporting category?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Table C vs Table D 比較
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Table C vs Table D Comparison

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA vs BLA Site 變更差異：
blocks.en: Differences in site changes between NDA/ANDA and BLA:

blocks.zh: 反直覺的發現：Testing site 變更，NDA/ANDA 需要 CBE-30，但 BLA 只需 AR。而 Sterilization site 變更則相反——BLA 需要 CBE-30，NDA/ANDA 只需 AR。不同的指引體系造成了這種不對稱性。
blocks.en: Counterintuitive finding: For a testing site change, NDA/ANDA needs a CBE-30 but BLA needs only an AR. For a sterilization site change it is the reverse: BLA needs a CBE-30 and NDA/ANDA only an AR. The different guidance frameworks produce this asymmetry.

blocks.zh: Table E: Changes to the Manufacturing or Processing of Glass Vials and Stoppers — NDA/ANDA Table E：玻璃瓶與瓶塞製造或加工變更 — NDA/ANDA
blocks.en: Table E: Changes to the Manufacturing or Processing of Glass Vials and Stoppers — NDA/ANDA

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Method vs Parameters
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Method vs Parameters

blocks.zh: Method 變更 vs Parameter 變更的分界線：
blocks.en: The dividing line between method changes and parameter changes:

blocks.zh: Table E 清楚展示了一個關鍵的法規區分：
blocks.en: Table E clearly illustrates a key regulatory distinction:

blocks.zh: Method 變更（方法變更）= PAS：例如滅菌方法從 moist heat 改為 dry heat，或從濕熱改為照射 (irradiation)。這是根本性的製程變更。
blocks.en: Method change = PAS: For example, changing the sterilization method from moist heat to dry heat, or from moist heat to irradiation. This is a fundamental process change.

blocks.zh: Parameter 變更（參數變更）= CBE-30：例如在同一滅菌方法（乾熱）下調整溫度或時間。這是同一方法框架內的微調。
blocks.en: Parameter change = CBE-30: For example, adjusting the temperature or time within the same sterilization method (dry heat). This is a fine adjustment within the same method framework.

blocks.zh: 這個「方法 vs 參數」的區分邏輯貫穿整個 Table E 和 Table F。
blocks.en: This "method vs parameter" logic runs through the whole of Table E and Table F.

blocks.zh: Stopper Siliconization 為何需要 PAS：矽化 (siliconization) 改變了瓶塞表面的化學性質，直接影響 extractables/leachables profile 和 CCS 完整性。這等同於「材料性質變更」而非單純的「製程參數調整」。
blocks.en: Why stopper siliconization needs a PAS: Siliconization changes the chemical properties of the stopper surface, directly affecting the extractables/leachables profile and CCS integrity. This is equivalent to a "material property change" rather than a simple "process parameter adjustment".

blocks.zh: Method vs Parameter 的差別就像烹飪中的「換烹調方式」vs「調整火候」：
blocks.en: The difference between method and parameter is like "changing the cooking method" vs "adjusting the heat" in cooking:

blocks.zh: Method 變更 (PAS)：從水煮改為油炸——完全不同的烹調方式，成品口感和營養成分都會不同
blocks.en: Method change (PAS): From boiling to deep frying: a completely different cooking method, so the texture and nutritional content of the finished dish will differ

blocks.zh: Parameter 變更 (CBE-30)：水煮溫度從 100°C 調到 95°C——同樣是水煮，只是微調條件
blocks.en: Parameter change (CBE-30): Boiling temperature adjusted from 100°C to 95°C: still boiling, just a fine adjustment of conditions

blocks.zh: 同樣地，stopper siliconization process 變更之所以是 PAS，是因為它相當於「給菜加了一層新的調味醬」——改變了表面化學性質，而不只是調整製程參數。
blocks.en: Similarly, a change to the stopper siliconization process is a PAS because it is equivalent to "adding a new layer of sauce to the dish": it changes the surface chemistry, not just the process parameters.

blocks.zh: CDMO 直接相關的變更：Table E 中的變更類型多數發生在 CDMO 環境中：
blocks.en: Changes directly relevant to CDMOs: Most of the change types in Table E occur in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: Vial sterilization/depyrogenation：如果 CDMO 自行做 vial 的 depyrogenation（如 dry heat tunnel），任何方法變更需要 PAS，參數變更需要 CBE-30
blocks.en: Vial sterilization/depyrogenation: If the CDMO performs vial depyrogenation itself (such as a dry heat tunnel), any method change needs a PAS and a parameter change needs a CBE-30

blocks.zh: Stopper washing：CDMO 自行洗瓶塞的流程變更只需 CBE-30
blocks.en: Stopper washing: A change to the CDMO's own stopper washing process needs only a CBE-30

blocks.zh: Stopper sterilization：方法變更（如從 autoclave 改為 gamma irradiation）需要 PAS；同一方法下的參數調整需要 CBE-30
blocks.en: Stopper sterilization: A method change (such as from autoclave to gamma irradiation) needs a PAS; a parameter adjustment within the same method needs a CBE-30

blocks.zh: 這些都是 CDMO 日常操作中可能遇到的變更，尤其在設備升級或製程優化時。
blocks.en: These are all changes a CDMO may encounter in daily operations, especially during equipment upgrades or process optimization.

blocks.zh: CDMO 製程變更案例分析：
blocks.en: CDMO process change case analysis:

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 計畫升級 depyrogenation tunnel，新設備的設計溫度從 350°C/3min 改為 300°C/5min（同為 dry heat depyrogenation）：
blocks.en: Your CDMO plans to upgrade its depyrogenation tunnel, and the design setpoint of the new equipment changes from 350°C/3min to 300°C/5min (still dry heat depyrogenation):

blocks.zh: 這是 method 變更還是 parameter 變更？→ Parameter 變更（方法仍是 dry heat）
blocks.en: Is this a method change or a parameter change? → Parameter change (the method is still dry heat)

blocks.zh: 通報類別 → CBE-30
blocks.en: Reporting category → CBE-30

blocks.zh: 需要的數據 → 新設備的驗證數據（endotoxin challenge test 等）
blocks.en: Data required → validation data for the new equipment (endotoxin challenge test, etc.)

blocks.zh: 需要通知的對象 → 所有使用此 tunnel 的客戶（NDA/BLA holders）
blocks.en: Who must be notified → all clients (NDA/BLA holders) who use this tunnel

blocks.zh: 但如果新設備從 dry heat 改為 VHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) 處理 → 這是 method 變更 → PAS → 需要完整的 E&L 數據和穩定性數據。
blocks.en: But if the new equipment changes from dry heat to VHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) treatment → this is a method change → PAS → complete E&L data and stability data are required.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前使用 autoclave 做 stopper sterilization。設備老化需要更換。新 autoclave 的品牌不同但使用相同的 saturated steam 方法。這屬於 method 變更還是 parameter 變更？通報類別是什麼？
blocks.en: Your CDMO currently uses an autoclave for stopper sterilization. The equipment is aging and must be replaced. The new autoclave is a different brand but uses the same saturated steam method. Is this a method change or a parameter change? What is the reporting category?

blocks.zh: 如果瓶塞供應商從 unprocessed 切換到 RTU（同時涉及 Table A 和 Table E 的變更），應如何處理通報類別的選擇？
blocks.en: If a stopper supplier switches from unprocessed to RTU (involving changes in both Table A and Table E), how should the choice of reporting category be handled?

blocks.zh: Table F: Changes to the Manufacturing or Processing of Glass Vials and Stoppers — BLA Table F：玻璃瓶與瓶塞製造或加工變更 — BLA
blocks.en: Table F: Changes to the Manufacturing or Processing of Glass Vials and Stoppers — BLA

blocks.zh: BLA 的「供應商控制降級」就像外包供應商的內部流程調整。假設你的公司外包 IT 服務給一家雲端供應商。如果供應商內部更換了伺服器品牌（他們的「sterilization method change」），你作為客戶需要知道並評估影響。但如果供應商只是調整了伺服器的運行參數（「parameter change」），且服務品質不變，你甚至可能不需要做什麼——因為這在他們的服務品質保證範圍內。
blocks.en: The BLA "supplier control downgrade" is like an outsourced supplier adjusting its internal processes. Suppose your company outsources IT services to a cloud provider. If the provider changes its server brand internally (its "sterilization method change"), you as the customer need to know and assess the impact. But if the provider merely adjusts the servers' operating parameters (a "parameter change") and service quality is unchanged, you may not need to do anything, because this falls within the scope of their service quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 六張表格的綜合決策框架
blocks.en: Key Notes: Integrated Decision Framework for the Six Tables

blocks.zh: CDMO 的查表決策流程圖：
blocks.en: The CDMO's table-lookup decision flow:

blocks.zh: Step 1：確認客戶的申請類型 → NDA/ANDA（查 A/C/E）或 BLA（查 B/D/F）
blocks.en: Step 1: Confirm the client's application type → NDA/ANDA (use A/C/E) or BLA (use B/D/F)

blocks.zh: Step 2：確認變更類型 → Properties（A/B）、Source/Site（C/D）、Manufacturing（E/F）
blocks.en: Step 2: Confirm the type of change → Properties (A/B), Source/Site (C/D), Manufacturing (E/F)

blocks.zh: Step 3：找到具體變更 → 查看 Reporting Category
blocks.en: Step 3: Find the specific change → read the Reporting Category

blocks.zh: Step 4：檢查 Specific Considerations → 是否有升級/降級觸發條件
blocks.en: Step 4: Check Specific Considerations → are there any upgrade/downgrade triggers?

blocks.zh: Step 5：評估是否有多重變更 → 以最高風險類別為準
blocks.en: Step 5: Assess whether there are multiple changes → the highest-risk category governs

blocks.zh: Step 6：決定是否使用 CP/ICH Q12 工具 → 申請降級（需先聯繫 FDA）
blocks.en: Step 6: Decide whether to use a CP/ICH Q12 tools → apply for a downgrade (contact FDA first)

blocks.zh: 綜合案例 — 全面 CCS 變更評估：
blocks.en: Integrated case: comprehensive CCS change assessment:

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 為一家生物製藥公司充填 mAb 產品（BLA）。公司決定：
blocks.en: Your CDMO fills a mAb product (BLA) for a biopharmaceutical company. The company decides to:

blocks.zh: 切換到新的瓶塞供應商（不同材料）→ Table B → PAS
blocks.en: Switch to a new stopper supplier (different material) → Table B → PAS

blocks.zh: 新供應商提供 RTU stoppers（之前是 unprocessed）→ Table B → CBE-30（可能降至 AR）
blocks.en: Have the new supplier provide RTU stoppers (previously unprocessed) → Table B → CBE-30 (possibly down to AR)

blocks.zh: 因為 RTU，CDMO 不再自行做 stopper washing → Table F → CBE-30（可能降至 AR）
blocks.en: Because the stoppers are RTU, the CDMO no longer washes stoppers itself → Table F → CBE-30 (possibly down to AR)

blocks.zh: 根據累積變更原則，整體通報類別 = PAS（以最高為準）。但可以利用 Comparability Protocol 預先規劃，未來類似變更降級為 CBE-30。
blocks.en: Under the cumulative change principle, the overall reporting category = PAS (the highest governs). However, a Comparability Protocol can be used to plan ahead so that similar future changes are downgraded to CBE-30.

blocks.zh: Table F 中的 Stopper siliconization process（BLA: CBE-30）vs Table E（NDA/ANDA: PAS）為什麼差異如此大？這對同時持有 NDA 和 BLA 的客戶有什麼策略啟示？
blocks.en: Why is the difference so large between the Stopper siliconization process in Table F (BLA: CBE-30) and in Table E (NDA/ANDA: PAS)? What strategic implication does this have for a client that holds both NDAs and BLAs?

blocks.zh: Table F 的降級條件反覆提到「vendor provides pre-xxx」。如果 CDMO 自行執行這些 processing（如 stopper washing、sterilization），是否仍能適用這些降級條件？為什麼？
blocks.en: The downgrade conditions in Table F repeatedly mention "vendor provides pre-xxx". If a CDMO performs this processing itself (such as stopper washing or sterilization), can these downgrade conditions still apply? Why?

blocks.zh: 設計一個 Comparability Protocol 框架，覆蓋 Table A-F 中最常見的 3 種 CCS 變更，使未來每次變更都能以 CBE-30 或 AR 通報。
blocks.en: Design a Comparability Protocol framework covering the 3 most common CCS changes in Tables A-F, so that each future change can be reported as a CBE-30 or AR.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Table E vs Table F 比較
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Table E vs Table F Comparison

blocks.zh: NDA/ANDA vs BLA 製程變更的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences in process changes between NDA/ANDA and BLA:

blocks.zh: 最顯著差異 — Stopper Siliconization：NDA/ANDA 需要 PAS，但 BLA 只需 CBE-30。這是因為 BLA 的 2021 年指引對此類供應商層級的變更有更寬鬆的分類。
blocks.en: Most notable difference: stopper siliconization: NDA/ANDA requires a PAS, but BLA requires only a CBE-30. This is because the 2021 BLA guidance classifies this kind of supplier-level change more leniently.

blocks.zh: BLA 的「供應商控制」降級原則：Table F 的 Specific Considerations 欄位反覆出現一個模式：「如果變更發生在供應商端（vendor provides pre-xxx and is changing the xxx process）」，可以降至 AR。這體現了 FDA 對供應商品質管理能力的信任——供應商內部的製程調整對藥品製造商的影響較間接。
blocks.en: The BLA "supplier control" downgrade principle: The Specific Considerations column of Table F repeatedly shows a pattern: "if the change occurs at the supplier (vendor provides pre-xxx and is changing the xxx process)", the category can be lowered to AR. This reflects FDA's trust in the supplier's quality management capability: process adjustments inside the supplier have a more indirect effect on the drug product manufacturer.

blocks.zh: Comprehensive Summary 六張表格綜合對照
blocks.en: Comprehensive Summary: Comparison of the Six Tables

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Summary Reference
blocks.en: Summary Reference

blocks.zh: 重點提示 跨表格策略洞察
blocks.en: Key Notes: Cross-Table Strategic Insights

blocks.zh: 五個 CDMO 應牢記的法規策略：
blocks.en: Five regulatory strategies every CDMO should remember:

blocks.zh: Dual Sourcing 最低門檻：同一供應商不同廠址 + 同規格 = Annual Report（Table C/D）
blocks.en: Lowest threshold for dual sourcing: Same supplier, different site + same specifications = Annual Report (Table C/D)

blocks.zh: BLA 不一定更嚴格：某些變更（如 molded/tubing 切換、siliconization process）BLA 反而比 NDA/ANDA 寬鬆
blocks.en: BLA is not necessarily stricter: For some changes (such as molded/tubing switching and the siliconization process), BLA is actually more lenient than NDA/ANDA

blocks.zh: 供應商控制 = 降級可能：變更發生在供應商端（vendor-controlled process）通常有降級路徑
blocks.en: Supplier control = possible downgrade: Changes that occur at the supplier (vendor-controlled process) usually have a downgrade path

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品 = 系統性升級：凍乾產品的 CCS 性質變更幾乎一律升級為 PAS
blocks.en: Lyophilized product = systematic upgrade: CCS property changes for lyophilized products are almost always upgraded to PAS

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol 是最強槓桿：預先核准的 CP 可以將 PAS 降為 CBE-30，對多產品/多次變更的 ROI 極高
blocks.en: The Comparability Protocol is the strongest lever: A pre-approved CP can lower a PAS to a CBE-30, with very high ROI for multiple products and repeated changes

blocks.zh: 與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的連結：PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.17–8.21 要求 CCS 完整性測試 (CCIT) 必須在首次使用前和定期執行。本 Guidance 的表格中多次要求提供 CCIT 數據，與 Annex 1 的要求完全一致。CDMO 應確保 CCIT 程序已納入 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS Strategy)。
blocks.en: Link to PIC/S Annex 1 (2022): PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.17–8.21 requires container closure integrity testing (CCIT) to be performed before first use and periodically. The tables in this guidance repeatedly require CCIT data, which is fully consistent with Annex 1. CDMOs should ensure the CCIT procedures are incorporated into the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS Strategy).

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 為 5 個客戶充填產品（3 個 NDA、2 個 BLA），全部使用同一規格的 10R Type I 玻璃瓶。供應商通知全球產能調整，需要從 tubing glass 切換到 molded glass。每個客戶分別需要什麼通報類別？如果其中一個是凍乾產品呢？
blocks.en: Your CDMO fills products for 5 clients (3 NDA, 2 BLA), all using the same specification of 10R Type I glass vials. The supplier announces a global capacity adjustment requiring a switch from tubing glass to molded glass. What reporting category does each client need? What if one of them is a lyophilized product?

blocks.zh: 基於六張表格的分析，為一家臨床期 CDMO 設計一份「CCS 變更影響評估 SOP」的框架大綱，包含查表流程、數據收集清單和客戶通知模板。
blocks.en: Based on the analysis of the six tables, design an outline framework for a "CCS Change Impact Assessment SOP" for a clinical-stage CDMO, including the table-lookup workflow, data collection checklist, and client notification template.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 六張表格是 CDMO 的日常法規工具：Table A-F 涵蓋了 glass vials 和 stoppers 的三大類變更（Properties、Source/Site、Manufacturing/Processing），分別針對 NDA/ANDA 和 BLA
blocks.en: The six tables are the CDMO's everyday regulatory tools: Tables A-F cover the three main categories of change for glass vials and stoppers (Properties, Source/Site, Manufacturing/Processing), separately for NDA/ANDA and BLA

blocks.zh: PAS 觸發條件：材料變更、容器類型變更、玻璃組成變更、stopper 材料變更、滅菌方法變更、siliconization 變更（NDA/ANDA）、凍乾產品的 molded/tubing 切換
blocks.en: PAS triggers: Material change, container type change, glass composition change, stopper material change, sterilization method change, siliconization change (NDA/ANDA), molded/tubing switch for lyophilized products

blocks.zh: CBE-30 觸發條件：Molded/tubing 切換（非凍乾 NDA/ANDA）、stopper 尺寸變更、stopper 供應方式變更、滅菌參數變更、瓶塞清洗製程變更
blocks.en: CBE-30 triggers: Molded/tubing switch (non-lyophilized NDA/ANDA), stopper dimension change, stopper supply method change, sterilization parameter change, stopper washing process change

blocks.zh: Annual Report 路徑：同供應商不同廠址（Table C/D）、同規格供應商切換（Table A Footnote 2）、BLA 的 molded/tubing 切換（Table B）
blocks.en: Annual Report pathways: Same supplier, different site (Table C/D); supplier switch with the same specifications (Table A Footnote 2); molded/tubing switch for BLA (Table B)

blocks.zh: BLA 的獨特降級機制：供應商控制的製程變更（vendor provides pre-xxx）多有降至 AR 的條件路徑
blocks.en: The unique BLA downgrade mechanism: For supplier-controlled process changes (vendor provides pre-xxx), there are mostly conditional pathways down to AR

blocks.zh: 累積變更原則：多重同時變更以最高風險類別為準。Comparability Protocol 可預先規劃，大幅降低未來變更的法規負擔
blocks.en: The cumulative change principle: For multiple concurrent changes, the highest-risk category governs. A Comparability Protocol can be planned in advance and greatly reduces the regulatory burden of future changes

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品的系統性升級：涉及玻璃瓶壁厚/熱傳導性質的變更，凍乾產品通常自動升級為 PAS
blocks.en: Systematic upgrade for lyophilized products: For changes involving glass vial wall thickness/heat transfer properties, lyophilized products are usually upgraded to PAS automatically

blocks.zh: CCIT 數據的核心角色：多數變更都要求 CCIT 數據，與 PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8 的要求一致
blocks.en: The central role of CCIT data: Most changes require CCIT data, consistent with the requirements of PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8
